title: Grill TUI re-asks a vague expected outcome

fields.summary: As a human grilling a story on a terminal, I want the interview to ask again when my expected outcome is vague, so that I fix it before review.
fields.completion_goal:
1. [recording] state: the grill story TUI with the expected outcome "works well"; expected: the interview asks a follow-up before the next question
2. [api-trace] state: `aayu grill story` with a draft whose expected outcome is "works well"; expected: the draft is reported with a vague-outcome problem
fields.scenario: Run the TUI with a scripted vague answer, then validate the same draft with flags.
fields.environment: local checkout with synthetic fixtures; never production
